# The Water Diplomacy Handbook

> Open-access companion site for the Routledge Handbook of Water Diplomacy
> (Islam, Smith, Klimes & Salzberg, eds., Routledge 2026). 54 chapters, 80+
> contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Free ebook: https://doi.org/10.4324/9781003178439

## Core pages

- [Table of contents](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/chapters/): all 54 chapters with authors and verified per-chapter DOIs
- [Explore by role or factor](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/explore/): guided reading pathways
- [Key themes](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/key-themes/): five cross-cutting themes
- [Brief overview](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/brief-overview/): the handbook's vision, audience, contributors, and editors
- [Detailed overview](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/detailed-overview/): why the handbook exists, who it is for, and how it is organized
- [Foreword by Jan Eliasson](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/foreword/)
- [Contributors](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/contributors/)

## Machine-readable data

- [chapters.json](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/data/chapters.json): canonical TOC with verified DOIs. NOTE: chapter DOIs are NOT chapter-number+1 (section introductions consume DOI slots). Use this file; do not compute DOIs.
